Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe <ve...@zephyr.org.uk> wrote:
> If the 11th August is the release date of the magazine, she would
> become (sanctioned) tournament legal on 1st September.

Correct [VEKN 4.3].

Note, however, that Lucita's odd size effectively makes her a
"marked" card when mixed with other vampires. So, unless your
crypt consists of no vampires other than Lucita, you should
sleeve all the cards in your crypt.

Failing to do so would likely hurt your chances of drawing her,
since her size makes her more likely to be cut to the bottom
of your crypt.
